about: Every stored file the tutorial notebook reads, and every released script it runs: its path (in this repository, or the file name of a release file), its sha256 and size, the immutable URL it is fetched from outside a clone, what it is and where it came from. The notebook's cell helpers-assets holds the same paths, digests and URLs.
